name: agent-observability
description: Privacy-first local view of GitHub Copilot, GitHub Copilot cloud coding-agent, and Claude Code agent telemetry. Raw data stays on your machine; only opt-in aggregates are ever shared.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Local Overview summarizes your GitHub Copilot, Copilot cloud coding-agent, and Claude Code agent activity, read on-disk from this machine.

Nothing is uploaded unless you opt in to aggregate sharing.

[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

Sessions lists your Copilot, Copilot cloud coding-agent, and Claude Code agent sessions — grouped by source and repository — with prompt, tool, model, duration and cost detail.

All session detail stays on this machine.

[Refresh](command:agentObservability.refresh)

Sync uploads only opt-in, aggregated, non-sensitive statistics to your organization dashboard. Raw prompts, completions, tool I/O, source-file paths and file contents never leave your machine.

When enabled, the only paths shared are repository-relative paths of customization files (instructions, skills, prompts, agents, hooks) — with counts, never contents — so your team can review context-engineering hotspots.

Cloud sharing is OFF by default.

[Set Organization API Key](command:agentObservability.setApiKey)
[Open Settings](command:agentObservability.openSettings)

Context Hotspots shows which customization files (instructions, skills, prompts, agents, hooks) appeared in your recent local sessions — busiest first — so you can drill down from a file to the concrete sessions that used it.

This is the LOCAL companion to the organization dashboard's aggregate hotspots. All detail stays on this machine.

[Refresh](command:agentObservability.refresh)

chatParticipants.name: obs
chatParticipants.description: Open a local agent session-detail view (@obs, or @obs <id or title>)

agentObservability.sync.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to share aggregated, non-sensitive statistics with your organization dashboard. Disabled by default (opt-out). Raw prompts, completions, and tool input/output are never uploaded, and neither are source- or document-file paths or any file contents. The only paths shared are repository-relative paths of customization files (instructions, skills, prompts, agents, hooks), sent with counts so your team can review context-engineering hotspots during sprint retrospectives.

agentObservability.sync.intervalMinutes.markdownDescription: How often background sync uploads aggregate batches, in minutes. Minimum 5.

enumDescriptions: Upload aggregates for every repository in your local telemetry.
Upload aggregates ONLY for the repositories listed in sync.repositories (default).
Upload aggregates for every repository EXCEPT those listed in sync.repositories.
agentObservability.sync.repositoryMode.markdownDescription: Which repositories are included in cloud sync. Cloud sync reads your MERGED local telemetry, which spans every repository you've used Copilot in — not just the open workspace — so this setting controls which of them leave the machine. `include` (default) uploads only the repositories in `#agentObservability.sync.repositories#` — so nothing is uploaded until you pick at least one; `all` uploads every repository; `exclude` uploads everything except those listed. Scoping is privacy-positive — it only ever uploads less. Run **Agent Observability: Choose Repositories to Sync** to pick from your local telemetry, or set `all` to upload everything. Set at the user level (cannot be overridden per-workspace).

agentObservability.sync.repositories.markdownDescription: Sanitized repository URLs (e.g. `https://github.com/org/repo`) that `#agentObservability.sync.repositoryMode#` applies to. Run **Agent Observability: Choose Repositories to Sync** to pick from the repositories found in your local telemetry instead of typing URLs by hand. The special value `unknown` matches sessions with no detected git remote. Hand-typed entries are normalized to canonical form, so `org/repo` shorthand and a trailing `.git` still match.

agentObservability.excludedRepositories.markdownDescription: Repositories to hide from the WHOLE extension. Unlike `#agentObservability.sync.repositoryMode#` (which only narrows what uploads), a repository listed here disappears from the local Overview and Sessions views AND is excluded from cloud sync and the payload preview. Run **Agent Observability: Choose Repositories to Hide** to pick from the repositories found in your local telemetry instead of typing URLs by hand. The special value `unknown` hides sessions with no detected git remote. Hand-typed entries are normalized to canonical form, so `org/repo` shorthand and a trailing `.git` still match. Local data is untouched — removing an entry brings the repository straight back.

agentObservability.localTelemetry.enable.markdownDescription: Feature flag to enable the local telemetry view. When disabled, the extension does not read the local Copilot telemetry database.

agentObservability.sqlitePath.markdownDescription: Override the path to the Copilot `agent-traces.db` SQLite database. Leave blank to auto-detect — auto-detection finds and MERGES every reachable database, so agent logs from both Windows and WSL appear together regardless of which environment the window runs in: on the Windows host the installed distros are scanned over `\\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...` in addition to the local `%APPDATA%` database, and inside a Remote-WSL window the `~/.vscode-server/data` location is checked alongside the Windows host's databases via `/mnt/c/Users/...`. Set this explicitly (e.g. `\\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu\home\me\.vscode-server\data\User\globalStorage\github.copilot-chat\agent-traces.db`) to pin a SINGLE database and disable merging.

agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionM.markdownDescription: Maximum expected duration of an agent session, in minutes, used by the local workflow-deviation detector to flag overlong sessions (TimeoutExceeded) when no explicit workflow is configured for the repository.

agentObservability.deviation.notifyOnDiv.markdownDescription: Show a VS Code notification when a configured workflow diverges within a user-request turn (a step is skipped or runs out of order). Off by default; per-turn divergences are always shown inline in the session-detail timeline regardless.

agentObservability.context.acceptedMissi.markdownDescription: Context file names that are accepted as missing. Files in this list will not appear in the "Expected but missing" section of the Context Analysis tab.
Source file names whose outgoing missing references should be suppressed. When a source file is listed here, any files referenced only by it will not appear in the "Expected but missing" section.

agentObservability.workflows.markdownDescription: Optional per-repository expected agent workflows for the local deviation detector. When a repository has an explicit entry here, sequence and missing-step checks are enabled in addition to the always-on timeout and failure-rate checks. All detection runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

repository.markdownDescription: Sanitized repository this configuration applies to (e.g. `https://github.com/org/repo`).

workflows.markdownDescription: Expected workflows to check this repository's sessions against.

expectedSequence.markdownDescription: Expected ordered agent names. When present, enables sequence and missing-step checks.

maxDurationMinutes.markdownDescription: Maximum expected workflow duration, in minutes. Defaults to `agentObservability.deviation.maxSessionMinutes` when omitted.

sequenceDeviationAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sequence and missing-step deviations. Requires `expectedSequence`.

timeoutExceededAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions that exceed the maximum duration.

toolUsageAnomalyAlert.markdownDescription: Flag sessions with a high (>50% over >=3 interactions) failure rate.

triggerPredicate.markdownDescription: Optional metadata applicability gate: the workflow applies to a user-request turn only when at least one of the turn's interactions matches. It never filters interactions — every check runs over the whole turn, so the trigger may be narrower than the steps. All fields are optional; an absent field matches any value; string fields compare case-insensitively.

toolName.markdownDescription: Match the tool name; interactions without a tool never match.

triggerContentPredicate.markdownDescription: **Local-only** content gate on the trigger, evaluated in ADDITION to `triggerPredicate`: the workflow applies to a user-request turn only when the turn's anchor (the user-request span) content matches. Lets relevance key on what the request is ABOUT — e.g. `copilot_chat.user_request` contains `/implement-new-feature` — which metadata alone cannot express. Evaluated entirely on this machine; the matched text NEVER leaves it and any deviation it produces is marked local-only and excluded from sync by construction. Requires one of `contains` or `matches`. An unsupported `attribute`, a missing condition, or an unsafe regex skips the whole workflow.

attribute.markdownDescription: Raw `span_attributes` key to inspect. Restricted to the forbidden-to-sync local-only content set (plus `copilot_chat.mode_name`). Any other key is rejected and the workflow is skipped. Use `copilot_chat.user_request` to match the user's prompt text (e.g. a `/slash-command`). For Claude Code sessions only `copilot_chat.user_request` is populated; other keys have no Claude equivalent and never match.

contains.markdownDescription: Case-insensitive substring to look for. Preferred over `matches` for simple checks.

matches.markdownDescription: Regex pattern to test against the attribute value. A conservative ReDoS-safe subset is enforced: regex alternation `|` under a repetition (e.g. `(a|b)+`) and other catastrophic-backtracking shapes are rejected and the workflow is skipped — use a character class such as `[ab]+` instead. Regex matching runs only over the first 1,000 characters of the value (vs 10,000 for `contains`) to bound backtracking cost. Prefer `contains` for simple checks.

negate.markdownDescription: Invert the match (e.g. assert the prompt does NOT contain the value).

steps.markdownDescription: Optional ordered, structured workflow steps. When present, predicate-based matching supersedes `expectedSequence` for the sequence and missing-step checks: each step must match at least one in-scope interaction, in order. All matching runs locally.

name.markdownDescription: Step name, shown in deviation descriptions.

predicate.markdownDescription: Metadata filter the step must match. All fields optional; an absent field matches any value; string fields compare case-insensitively.

toolName.markdownDescription: Match the tool name; interactions without a tool never match.

contentPredicate.markdownDescription: **Local-only** content condition over a raw span attribute. Evaluated entirely on this machine; the matched text NEVER leaves it and any deviation it produces is marked local-only and excluded from sync by construction. Requires one of `contains` or `matches`. An unsupported `attribute`, a missing condition, or an unsafe regex causes the whole step to be skipped.

attribute.markdownDescription: Raw `span_attributes` key to inspect. Restricted to the forbidden-to-sync local-only content set (plus `copilot_chat.mode_name`). Any other key is rejected and the step is skipped.

contains.markdownDescription: Case-insensitive substring to look for. Preferred over `matches` for simple checks.

matches.markdownDescription: Regex pattern to test against the attribute value. A conservative ReDoS-safe subset is enforced: regex alternation `|` under a repetition (e.g. `(a|b)+`) and other catastrophic-backtracking shapes are rejected and the step is skipped — use a character class such as `[ab]+` instead. Regex matching runs only over the first 1,000 characters of the value (vs 10,000 for `contains`) to bound backtracking cost. Prefer `contains` for simple checks.

negate.markdownDescription: Invert the match (e.g. assert the content does NOT contain the value).

agentObservability.analysis.codeFileExte.markdownDescription: File extensions counted as **source code** (LoC / nLoC) on the local session-detail panel. Lines the agent writes to / removes from files with these extensions are tallied by reading each file-writing tool call's arguments. Classification is by extension only; files matching neither this nor `#agentObservability.analysis.docFileExtensions#` are ignored. Leading dots are optional and case is ignored. Computed entirely locally from raw tool arguments — nothing is ever uploaded.

agentObservability.analysis.docFileExten.markdownDescription: File extensions counted as **documentation** (LoD / nLoD) on the local session-detail panel. Lines the agent writes to / removes from files with these extensions are tallied by reading each file-writing tool call's arguments. Classification is by extension only; files matching neither this nor `#agentObservability.analysis.codeFileExtensions#` are ignored. Leading dots are optional and case is ignored. Computed entirely locally from raw tool arguments — nothing is ever uploaded.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable near-real-time updates: run a localhost OpenTelemetry receiver that GitHub Copilot Chat's `otlp-http` exporter pushes spans to, ingest them into the extension's own database (Copilot's schema), and refresh the views + workflow notifications live as an agent runs. Off by default. Use the **Agent Observability: Enable Live Updates (Copilot OTel)** command to turn this on — it configures Copilot's `#github.copilot.chat.otel.enabled#` / `exporterType` / `otlpEndpoint` settings and requires a **full VS Code restart** (a window reload is not enough). Everything stays local; nothing is uploaded.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.debounceM.markdownDescription: Coalescing window, in milliseconds, between ingesting new spans and refreshing the views. Lower feels more live but refreshes more often; minimum 100.

agentObservability.liveUpdates.otelPort.markdownDescription: Localhost port the extension's OpenTelemetry receiver listens on (set automatically by **Enable Live Updates**; `0` until then). Copilot's `#github.copilot.chat.otel.otlpEndpoint#` is pointed at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`.

agentObservability.copilotArchive.enable.markdownDescription: Keep a **durable archive** of GitHub Copilot agent sessions. Copilot writes only a short, rolling `agent-traces.db` inside VS Code's per-edition `globalStorage`, so history is lost and sessions differ between windows. When on (default), the extension continuously copies Copilot's spans into a single archive under your home directory (`~/.agent-observability/copilot/agent-traces.db`), so sessions persist and appear in **every** VS Code window and edition on this machine — the way Claude Code sessions already do. Zero setup; runs in the background; nothing is uploaded. History that Copilot rotated out before the archive first ran cannot be recovered.

agentObservability.copilotArchive.path.markdownDescription: Override the archive database file path. Leave blank to use `AGENT_OBSERVABILITY_HOME/copilot/agent-traces.db` if that environment variable is set, else `~/.agent-observability/copilot/agent-traces.db`. Set this only to relocate the archive.

agentObservability.copilotArchive.retent.markdownDescription: How many days of Copilot sessions the archive retains. Older sessions are pruned on each sweep. Defaults to 180 days — long enough to beat Copilot's short rolling window. The archive stores only non-sensitive metadata (counts, tokens, models, timings), so it grows slowly.

agentObservability.copilotArchive.sweepI.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) the extension copies new Copilot spans into the archive while VS Code is open. Lower captures sooner but does slightly more background work; minimum 10.

agentObservability.claudeCode.enabled.markdownDescription: Capture **Claude Code** agent sessions. When on, the extension reads Claude Code's JSON-lines transcripts from `~/.claude/projects` and shows those sessions alongside GitHub Copilot in the unified Overview and Sessions views (grouped under a **Claude Code** source node). Transcripts are read locally and on demand; raw prompts, completions, and tool I/O never leave the machine. Like Copilot, only opt-in, pre-aggregated, non-sensitive statistics are ever uploaded (gated on `#agentObservability.sync.enabled#`).

agentObservability.claudeCode.projectsPa.markdownDescription: Override the path to Claude Code's `projects` directory. Leave blank to auto-detect: the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable's `projects` subdirectory if set, else `~/.claude/projects`. Set this only if your transcripts live elsewhere.

agentObservability.claudeCode.scanDepth.markdownDescription: Maximum directory depth to recurse when scanning the projects directory for Claude Code transcripts (`*.jsonl`). The `subagents/` subtree of a session is ALWAYS scanned regardless of this limit (so deeply-nested sub-agent side-chains like `subagents/workflows/wf_*/` are never missed); this bounds only the project-tree walk above it. Raise it only for unusually deep project nesting.

agentObservability.claudeCode.maxSession.markdownDescription: Maximum number of most-recently-active Claude Code sessions to surface in the Sessions list (and aggregate for sync) at once. Bounds the synchronous transcript-parsing cost so the tree stays responsive when a machine has accumulated thousands of sessions. Older sessions beyond this count are reported via an info row rather than dropped silently. Full token/cost detail for any shown session is computed lazily and cached.

enumDescriptions: Use your GitHub Copilot subscription via VS Code's built-in language model API (default).
Use the Claude Code CLI installed on this machine, under your own Anthropic login.
agentObservability.aiHelper.backend.markdownDescription: Which AI backend answers **AI Helper** chats. `claude-code` requires the Claude Code CLI installed and signed in; requests run locally via `claude -p` with all tools disabled and no session files written. The AI Helper's backend dropdown writes this setting.

agentObservability.aiHelper.copilotModel.markdownDescription: Copilot model id or family for the AI Helper (e.g. `gpt-4o`). Leave blank to use the first available model. The AI Helper's model dropdown writes this setting.

agentObservability.aiHelper.claudeModel.markdownDescription: Claude model for the AI Helper when `#agentObservability.aiHelper.backend#` is `claude-code`: an alias (`sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable`) or any full model id (e.g. `claude-sonnet-5`). Custom ids typed here appear in the model dropdown as `(custom)`.

agentObservability.aiHelper.claudeEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort passed to the Claude Code CLI (`--effort`). Ignored by the Copilot backend. Note: `xhigh` is not supported by every model — unsupported combinations surface as an error in the chat.

agentObservability.aiHelper.claudeCliPat.markdownDescription: Path to the Claude Code CLI executable. Leave blank to use `claude` from your PATH (on Windows, `claude.cmd` is also tried automatically). Set this only if the CLI is installed somewhere unusual.

agentObservability.copilotCloud.enabled.markdownDescription: Capture **GitHub Copilot cloud coding-agent** sessions. When on, a background poller pulls your cloud-agent task/session logs (via the GitHub API, authenticated through the `gh` CLI or a per-account token) into a local sink under your home directory and shows them alongside Copilot and Claude Code under a **Copilot (Cloud)** source node. Off by default (opt-in). Raw prompts, tool I/O, and assistant text are stored locally and never uploaded — cloud sessions are local-only (org sharing is a separate, future decision).

agentObservability.copilotCloud.accounts.markdownDescription: GitHub CLI usernames whose cloud-agent tasks to poll. Identities are pinned here (rather than following `gh auth switch`) so the polled account never changes unexpectedly. Leave empty and the extension captures the currently-active `gh` login once when you enable the source; edit the list to poll multiple accounts. Each account uses `gh auth token --user <name>` (or a token set via **Copilot (Cloud): Set account token**).

agentObservability.copilotCloud.ghCliPat.markdownDescription: Path to the GitHub CLI (`gh`) executable used to mint per-account tokens. Leave blank to use `gh` from your PATH (on Windows, `gh.exe`/`gh.cmd` are also tried). Set this only if `gh` is installed somewhere unusual. Accounts with a token set via **Copilot (Cloud): Set account token** do not require `gh`.

agentObservability.copilotCloud.idlePoll.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll the GitHub API for cloud-agent tasks while none is actively running. Minimum 60. A single window polls (elected via a lease); the poll cadence speeds up automatically while a task is in progress (see `#agentObservability.copilotCloud.activePollSeconds#`).

agentObservability.copilotCloud.activePo.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll while a cloud-agent task is actively running (queued / in progress / waiting for user), so state and logs update sooner. Minimum 30.

enumDescriptions: Poll only the authenticated user's own cloud-agent tasks (privacy-first default).
Also poll the workspace repositories' tasks, surfacing teammates' cloud-agent runs (with creator attribution).
agentObservability.copilotCloud.scope.markdownDescription: Which cloud-agent tasks to fetch. `my-tasks` (default) is personal — only your own tasks. `repos` also surfaces teammates' tasks in the workspace repositories (same GitHub access as github.com); their prompts are then visible locally.

agentObservability.copilotCloud.retentio.markdownDescription: How many days of polled cloud-agent tasks the local sink retains. Older tasks (and their raw logs) are pruned on each poll. Defaults to 180 days.

agentObservability.copilotCloud.maxTasks.markdownDescription: Maximum number of most-recent cloud-agent tasks to fetch and surface per account, bounding request and parse cost.

agentObservability.copilotAgent.enabled.markdownDescription: Capture **autonomous Copilot CLI agent** sessions (e.g. an Azure Container Apps job that remediates an alert) that push their full `gen_ai.*` OpenTelemetry to a cloud landing spot. When on, a background poller pulls those raw OTLP batches into a local sink under your home directory and shows them alongside Copilot and Claude Code under a **Copilot (Autonomous)** source node. Off by default (opt-in). Requires `#agentObservability.copilotAgent.endpoint#` and a relay token set via **Copilot (Autonomous): Set relay token**. The batches carry full prompts and tool I/O by design for this source; they are stored locally and never re-uploaded.

agentObservability.copilotAgent.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the cloud landing spot that autonomous-agent OTLP is pulled from (the relay's read API). Leave blank to keep the **Copilot (Autonomous)** source inert — nothing is pulled. Authenticated with a bearer token set via **Copilot (Autonomous): Set relay token**.

agentObservability.copilotAgent.idlePoll.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll the relay for new autonomous-agent OTLP batches while none arrived on the previous poll. Minimum 60. A single window polls (elected via a lease); the cadence speeds up automatically right after a batch is pulled (see `#agentObservability.copilotAgent.activePollSeconds#`).

agentObservability.copilotAgent.activePo.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to poll right after a poll that pulled new autonomous-agent batches, so a burst of activity catches up sooner. Minimum 30.

agentObservability.copilotAgent.retentio.markdownDescription: How many days of pulled autonomous-agent telemetry the local sink retains. Older spans (and their archived raw batches) are pruned on each poll. Defaults to 180 days.

agentObservability.copilotAgent.maxSessi.markdownDescription: Maximum number of raw OTLP batches to pull in a single poll, bounding download and parse cost against a large backlog.
